{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure a clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check explicitly for QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order rows:\")
print(qa_orders)

# Check if any QA orders are in the loyal completed group
qa_in_loyal_completed = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (qa_orders['status'] == 'completed')]
print("\nQA orders in loyal completed group:", len(qa_in_loyal_completed))
print("QA order rows in loyal completed group:\")
print(qa_in_loyal_completed)"}
